newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech c.bank bill auction net yield hits 9.56 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech c.bank bill auction net yield hits 9.56 pct.

text.p: Net yield in an auction of a five billion crown tranche of Czech National Bank (CNB) 13-week liquidity bills hit 9.56 percent, the CNB said in a statement on Thursday.
The CNB statement said gross yield in the auction was 12.75 percent and that it accepted all of the 4.036 billion crowns worth of bids.
Comparative results from the last auction of similar bills were not immediately available.
